objective: Gate quirurgico 5D paso 1. Auditar exclusivamente en solo lectura el principal dbo.HUB_Escritura para determinar si sirve como migration writer controlado de Development. Revisar existencia, roles fijos, permisos explicitos de database/schema/objetos necesarios para CREATE TABLE, ALTER dbo, INSERT/UPDATE en Sistema_RBAC_Permisos y INSERT en Sistema_RBAC_RolesPermisos. No autenticar como HUB_Escritura, no leer secretos, no cambiar permisos, no DDL/DML, no tocar Production.

queries.name: hub_escritura_roles
queries.sql: SELECT member_principal.name AS member_name,role_principal.name AS role_name,role_principal.is_fixed_role FROM sys.database_role_members drm JOIN sys.database_principals role_principal ON role_principal.principal_id=drm.role_principal_id JOIN sys.database_principals member_principal ON member_principal.principal_id=drm.member_principal_id WHERE member_principal.name='HUB_Escritura' ORDER BY role_principal.name

queries.name: hub_escritura_database_permissions
queries.sql: SELECT pr.name AS principal_name,pe.state_desc,pe.permission_name,pe.class_desc FROM sys.database_permissions pe JOIN sys.database_principals pr ON pr.principal_id=pe.grantee_principal_id WHERE pr.name='HUB_Escritura' AND pe.class=0 ORDER BY pe.state_desc,pe.permission_name

queries.name: hub_escritura_schema_object_permissions
queries.sql: SELECT pr.name AS principal_name,pe.state_desc,pe.permission_name,pe.class_desc,CASE WHEN pe.class=3 THEN SCHEMA_NAME(pe.major_id) WHEN pe.class=1 THEN OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(pe.major_id) END AS schema_name,CASE WHEN pe.class=1 THEN OBJECT_NAME(pe.major_id) END AS object_name FROM sys.database_permissions pe JOIN sys.database_principals pr ON pr.principal_id=pe.grantee_principal_id WHERE pr.name='HUB_Escritura' AND pe.class IN (1,3) ORDER BY pe.class_desc,schema_name,object_name,pe.permission_name

queries.name: hub_escritura_role_permissions
queries.sql: SELECT role_principal.name AS role_name,pe.state_desc,pe.permission_name,pe.class_desc,CASE WHEN pe.class=3 THEN SCHEMA_NAME(pe.major_id) WHEN pe.class=1 THEN OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(pe.major_id) END AS schema_name,CASE WHEN pe.class=1 THEN OBJECT_NAME(pe.major_id) END AS object_name FROM sys.database_role_members drm JOIN sys.database_principals role_principal ON role_principal.principal_id=drm.role_principal_id JOIN sys.database_principals member_principal ON member_principal.principal_id=drm.member_principal_id LEFT JOIN sys.database_permissions pe ON pe.grantee_principal_id=role_principal.principal_id WHERE member_principal.name='HUB_Escritura' ORDER BY role_principal.name,pe.class_desc,schema_name,object_name,pe.permission_name

queries.name: required_target_objects_present
queries.sql: SELECT o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o WHERE o.name IN ('Sistema_RBAC_Permisos','Sistema_RBAC_Roles','Sistema_RBAC_RolesPermisos','Sistema_NotificacionesConfig','Operativo_Notificaciones_Log') ORDER BY o.name

queries.name: communications_queue_current_state
queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID('dbo.Operativo_Notificaciones_Queue','U') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS queue_present,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Operativo_Notificaciones_Queue')) AS queue_columns,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Operativo_Notificaciones_Queue') AND name IN ('IX_Operativo_Notificaciones_Queue_Pendientes','IX_Operativo_Notificaciones_Queue_Lock')) AS queue_indexes

queries.name: notifications_rbac_current_state
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS permissions_present FROM dbo.Sistema_RBAC_Permisos WHERE codigo IN ('NOTIFICACIONES_VER','NOTIFICACIONES_CONFIGURAR','NOTIFICACIONES_ENVIAR')
